connect_pybullet_vr_server: connect to a PyBullet VR physics server using SHARED_MEMORY or GUI mode
load_urdf_models: load URDF models like plane.urdf and cube.urdf into the PyBullet simulation
start_vr_state_logging: start state logging for VR controllers, generic robots, and contact points to binary files
poll_vr_events: poll VR device events for HMD and generic tracker position, orientation, and button state
render_debug_lines: render colored debug lines in the viewport to visualize VR controller orientation axes and drawing
